
```jsx
import { CxDropdownToggle } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxDropdownToggle from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/dropdown/CxDropdownToggle'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **active** | Toggle the active state for the component. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **caret** | Enables pseudo element caret on toggler. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | true |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **component** | Component used for the root node. Either a string to use a HTML element or a component. | `string` \| `ComponentClass<any, any>` \| `FunctionComponent<any>` \| `undefined` | - |
| **context** | Sets the context context of the component to one of Bootstrap React’s themed colors. | `'primary'` \| `'secondary'` \| `'success'` \| `'danger'` \| `'warning'` \| `'info'` \| `'dark'` \| `'light'` \| `string` | - |
| **disabled** | Toggle the disabled state for the component. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **href** | The href attribute specifies the URL of the page the link goes to. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **role** | The role attribute describes the role of an element in programs that can make use of it, such as screen readers or magnifiers. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **shape** | Select the shape of the component. | `'rounded'` \| `'rounded-top'` \| `'rounded-end'` \| `'rounded-bottom'` \| `'rounded-start'` \| `'rounded-circle'` \| `'rounded-pill'` \| `'rounded-0'` \| `'rounded-1'` \| `'rounded-2'` \| `'rounded-3'` \| `string` | - |
| **size** | Size the component small or large. | `'small'` \| `'large'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **split** | Similarly, create split button dropdowns with virtually the same markup as single button dropdowns, but with the addition of `.dropdown-toggle-split` className for proper spacing around the dropdown caret. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **trigger** | Sets which event handlers you’d like provided to your toggle prop. You can specify one trigger or an array of them. | `'hover'` \| `'focus'` \| `'click'` | click |
| **variant** | Set the button variant to an outlined button or a ghost button. | `'outline'` \| `undefined` | - |
